title: Omp only
situation: Supporting several harnesses split attention before the substrate worked. Decision 0012 was seeded into the workflow context because it decides no concept; a decision belongs to the context it decides about, and omp only is about how the corpus reaches a harness, so it belongs to delivery (architect's ruling of 2026-10-10). It is re-recorded here, superseding 0012.
decision: omp is the only supported harness. The Claude Code adapter and its tests are deleted; forge's adapter seam stays, with omp as its one implementation. Parity is a later decision.
consequences: Capability port (decision 0009) keeps future parity cheap.
